name: Hiring payment: opted-in provider
description: FLP-1947. SLD POSTs a draft 2-year apprenticeship for a 17-year-old learner (Riley Hayes, DOB 2009-06-01, start 2026-10-01, expected end 2028-09-30) for opted-in provider 10005077, and a NON-LEVY employer approves it. The learner is on the full calculation, so on approval they earn the normal 16-18 incentives (4 rows) plus the hiring payment: £1,000 on day 90 (2026-12-29, 2627 DP5) and £1,000 on day 365 (2027-09-30, 2728 DP2). The hiring payment is only calculated on approval, because the levy status isn't known before then.
